outlet_headlines.title: Anthropic revenue jumps to over $11.5 billion in Q2, up 14-fold year over year, first quarter of positive adjusted operating income
Mark Zuckerberg posts 6,500-word essay 'The Future is for Everyone', making the case for giving every person personal superintelligence
Meta releases Muse Glimmer, an Apache 2.0 open-weight 30B-parameter agentic AI model that runs on a single consumer GPU
Google's $15 billion Visakhapatnam data centre project (with Adani) faces court challenges over water and wildlife concerns; next hearing Aug 24
OpenAI introduces $125/month Premium seats for ChatGPT Business, giving power users 5x usage and removing the five-hour cap
China-linked hackers ran a four-day, near-fully-autonomous AI-agent cyberattack on Taiwanese government systems, first disclosed case of its kind
iQOO Z11 India launch officially confirmed for August 20, with AI productivity tools and dual rear cameras
Nvidia stock sheds $130B in market value after entering $500 billion AI infrastructure financing deal with Blackstone, KKR, Goldman Sachs, others
Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash with a 50% introductory price cut and coding benchmark jump to 65.3% on DeepSWE
Reddit shares jump 11% on S&P 500 inclusion announcement; will join the index Aug 18, replacing AvalonBay Communities
Workday shares post best day in 10 years, surging up to 25%, on report Silver Lake is in talks for a buyout of up to $43 billion
Apple's Tim Cook and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick open Apple's Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston, which will build Mac Minis and AI servers
Cisco shares slide 8% despite a Q4 earnings beat and stronger-than-expected FY2027 revenue and EPS guidance
OpenAI's Astra model produces formally-verified proofs for 10 open math/CS problems, including the first explicit non-sofic group, for ~$2,000 in compute
ChatGPT is nearing 1 billion weekly active users, about seven months after OpenAI's internal target for the milestone
DARPA and the US Air Force fly an AI-controlled F-16 (VENOM program) autonomously, a test pilot able to switch between human and AI control mid-flight

cn_incubator.title: Xiaohongshu has become the go-to hub for China's AI research community: AMA threads from Kai-Fu Lee (01.AI), Tsinghua's Zhiyuan Liu, Megvii's Qi Yin, and Qwen/Hunyuan/Kimi researchers have drawn 120M+ cumulative views since September
cn_incubator.provenance: RecodeChinaAI (English newsletter covering Chinese AI) frames this as a notable behavioral shift -- top AI researchers doing public AMAs on a lifestyle app -- with Kimi and Zhipu's GLM both shipping agents built specifically to generate Xiaohongshu content.

cn_incubator.title: 'Quiet livestreaming' -- calm, soft-sell live commerce is displacing hard-sell Douyin/Taobao-style hosting on Xiaohongshu (e.g. celebrity host Annie Yi drawing 2.2M viewers / ~$4.1M sales with a low-key format)
cn_incubator.provenance: Jing Daily reports the soft-sell format outperforming loud hard-sell norms as younger consumers tire of high-pressure livestream sales; independently listed as one of Xiaohongshu/RED's 2026 'Top 10 Buzzwords' by China Skinny.

cn_incubator.title: Bilibili is rolling out HAI ('Codename H'), a script-to-video AI tool that turns a ~1,000-word script into a ~6-minute video, positioned as a native competitor to CapCut AI for creators
cn_incubator.provenance: KrAsia frames this as Bilibili's next-phase monetization and creator-retention push, in a summer 2026 rollout; the same feature set is independently described by AI-tooling blog BibiGPT.

cn_incubator.title: China's new AI-companion rules (effective July 15) forced ByteDance's Doubao, Alibaba's Qwen and Tencent's Yuanbao to kill anthropomorphic/companion chatbot features overnight, triggering mass 'digital breakups' -- a live lifestyle-tech backlash story, adjacent to Xiaohongshu/Weibo discourse though not confirmed as trending on those apps specifically
cn_incubator.platform: doubao (bytedance) -- adjacent CN app, not xiaohongshu/bilibili/weibo
cn_incubator.provenance: Rest of World reports Beijing's Apr 10 'Interim Measures for AI Anthropomorphic Interactive Services' cut companion features off overnight across Doubao (345M MAU), Qwen and Yuanbao on July 15; corroborated independently by CNN Business, TechRadar, and Yahoo Finance/qz.com coverage of the same rules.

cn_incubator.title: Xiaohongshu's 2026 content-culture shift: 'seeding' posts are moving away from chasing viral moments toward playful absurdity, memes and self-deprecating humor as everyday stress-coping content
cn_incubator.provenance: China Skinny's 2026 'Top 10 Buzzwords' roundup for Xiaohongshu/RED flags absurdist humor and meme remixing as a rising content mode, distinct from prior viral-moment-chasing seeding tactics.
